goal: Bring bug fixes and performance improvements from master into the 32.x release branch for 32.0rc2
Prevents fee estimation failures, speeds up CLI utilities, and avoids unintended peer bans
agreement: Verified that backported commits are clean and functionally correct (willcl-ark)
Concept approval with requests to include additional backports (ismaelsadeeq)
Suggested including another PR in the backport set (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it updates release codesigning scripts and CI configuration for the 32.0 branch
Ensures build and signing integrity for upcoming release candidate binaries

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because fee estimation falls back to block policy instead of failing when mempool data is missing
Users and wallets get usable fee estimates even when the mempool estimator lacks data

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because misbehaving private broadcast connections no longer trigger node-wide IP discouragement
Node operators avoid banning peer addresses while still disconnecting misbehaving connections

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because standalone CLI tools detect hardware SHA256 acceleration instead of using slow fallbacks
Users running utilities like bitcoin-tx see substantial speedups during signing and hashing

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because queued validation callbacks now drain before saving fee estimates at shutdown
Prevents node operators from losing recent block updates in persisted fee estimation data
